note.en: Six challenges in any order (challenge six can end in a death or missing-in-action event); once all six are done, “Fever Broken” appears; about five years later, Storm Frenzy begins.

notes.zh: 进度0–750分三个阶段，基础每月+10；方针需先完成“酝酿风暴”项目（3105）才能选择。阶段1进入1天后3100，阶段2进入时3140，阶段3进入时3170；每月故事事件3110/3130（阶段1）与3160（阶段2）；完成时3190。
notes.en: Progress 0-750 in three stages, base +10 a month; the approaches unlock only after the Tempest Brewing project (3105). Stage 1 -> 3100 after 1 day, stage 2 -> 3140, stage 3 -> 3170; monthly story events 3110 / 3130 (stage 1) and 3160 (stage 2); completion fires 3190 (common/situations/07_cosmic_storms_situations.txt:431-600).
